identity.primary_object: Current manga page and its editable text Regions
identity.dominant_time_model: Project revision with undoable Region commands; OCR and translation are transient page operations
identity.core_outcome: A reviewed, editable translated manga page ready for typesetting and export
identity.hero_interaction: Directly select a Region on the current page and compare or correct its source, translation, and layout
identity.signature_surface: A centered paper page on a neutral pasteboard, with selection geometry and proof context serving direct editing

aligned.name: Godot editor tour
aligned.fit: A spatial authoring reference because canvas selection controls the meaning of property tools.
transferred_traits: Keep the authored visual artifact dominant.
Bind selection, properties, and commands to the same object.
Preserve the viewport by moving auxiliary panels to drawers at narrow widths.
rejected_traits: Scene-tree semantics and game-engine branding do not fit manga page review.
Persistent diagnostic docks must not compete with the page.

contrast.name: Zed project-panel guidance
contrast.fit: A contrast reference for restrained contextual tools and focused narrow layouts.
transferred_traits: Keep rare tools contextual while the central artifact stays quiet.
Use mutually exclusive supporting surfaces at narrow widths.
rejected_traits: Code-editor tabs and collaborator affordances are not manga editing objects.
Minimalism must not hide OCR failure or manual-override status.

user_signals: The P5 supplement requires a continuous current-page workbench, not a task-panel collection.
The task requires three neutral high-fidelity concepts and an unselected human-review gate.
project_signals: docs/ui/foundations.md establishes Win11 Fluent semantics, Mica, 4 px rhythm, and a neutral dark canvas even in Light theme.
docs/ui/pages/editor.md defines PageThumbnailList, MangaCanvas, Inspector, CommandBar, and AppStatusTaskStrip as the editor anatomy.

non_ui_reference.name: Printed manga page and editorial proof sheet
transferred_traits: Paper edge, margin, selection marks, and reading order create a careful proofing rhythm.
A page can remain calm while only active regions carry precise marks.
rejected_traits: No reproduction of copyrighted manga art or publisher typography.
No faux paper texture that reduces field legibility.

recent_patterns_to_avoid: A generic persistent navigation, session, chat, and Inspector skeleton unrelated to the page.
A dashboard grid of identical rounded cards, decorative gradients, or status-only metrics.

subject_vernacular.tempo: Careful page-by-page proofreading with short, nonblocking machine-assist intervals

art_direction.visual_world: A restrained editorial pasteboard: a white manga page is held in a neutral working field, while proof rules, selected geometry, and compact margin tools make edits legible without turning the page into a dashboard.
art_direction.signature_element: A paper-centered canvas whose selected Region, thumbnail, and proof context share a single thin registration rule and explicit labels.
art_direction.typography_voice: System UI typography with 14 px CJK body copy, compact 12 px metadata, and semibold section anchors; translated text is readable before chrome is decorative.
art_direction.palette_strategy: Fluent semantic Light and Dark surfaces frame one stable neutral canvas. Accent identifies selection and one primary action; warning and error remain semantic and paired with text or icons.
art_direction.motion_voice: Short 160–220 ms selection and pane transitions clarify continuity; direct Region manipulation is immediate and Reduce Motion removes nonessential shimmer and movement.

aesthetic_risk.move: Keep the canvas a deep neutral pasteboard in both themes so the paper edge and Region geometry retain authority.
aesthetic_risk.evidence: The foundations and editor specification explicitly preserve a neutral deep canvas even in Light theme.
aesthetic_risk.quiet_zone: Navigation, Inspector fields, page rows, and the task strip stay low-chroma and structurally quiet.
aesthetic_risk.usability_guard: All status uses text plus icon or shape, selection has handles and a high-contrast double outline, and no field text depends on the pasteboard for contrast.
aesthetic_risk.fallback: If contrast or accessibility review rejects the deep pasteboard, use the Fluent canvas semantic surface with the same paper-edge and double-outline hierarchy.

anti_goals: A generic AI dashboard that makes task progress more prominent than the page.
Opaque-card proliferation around every Inspector group or proofreading row.
Decorative manga motifs, gradients, glow, or copied artwork used as identity.

genericity_review.default_solution: A conventional three-pane settings shell with a white canvas, equal-weight cards, and a decorative accent gradient.
detected_cliches: Treating every Inspector group as an elevated rounded card.
Using color alone for selected, running, and failed state.
Making three concepts differ only by accent color.

revisions.from: A pale blank canvas and card-stack Inspector
revisions.to: A paper-centered neutral pasteboard with flat proof rules, explicit Region marks, and bounded Fluent field groups
revisions.reason: The revision exposes the physical page, direct manipulation, and editorial tempo that distinguish manga review.

genericity_review.recognizable_without_brand: The centered page, measured registration rules, visible Region geometry, and proofing cadence still identify the tool when color and marks are removed.

density.note: Compact command and list cadence while keeping multiline translation fields readable.

contrast.note: Quiet neutral chrome with emphatic paper edge, selection marks, and recoverable error.

material_depth.note: Mica shows through quiet gaps; only persistent panes and the drawer have bounded surface elevation.

corner_softness.note: Crisp 4–8 px Fluent radii keep the proofing surface technical rather than bubbly.

motion_energy.note: Motion explains pane and selection continuity; direct manipulation and reduced-motion states are immediate.

visual_expressiveness.note: The editorial pasteboard and registration rule provide one signature move while chrome remains restrained.

concepts.title: 画布优先 · 稳定属性栏
concepts.primary_surface: Centered manga canvas with a stable right Inspector
concepts.hero_interaction: Select Region 08 on the page and refine its translation without leaving the canvas
concepts.narrow_behavior: Page rail and Inspector become mutually exclusive overlays below 720 px; canvas and command bar remain fixed.
concepts.failure_risk: A persistent Inspector can reduce canvas width if its minimum width is not enforced.

visual_direction.name: 纸页基准线
visual_direction.composition_character: A calm three-column proof desk: compact rails frame a large dark pasteboard and the Inspector reads as a measured editorial margin.
visual_direction.palette_strategy: Neutral Fluent surfaces surround a charcoal canvas; muted teal is reserved for selected geometry and one primary recovery action.
visual_direction.type_strategy: System UI text keeps controls compact while CJK body copy receives stable 14 px lines and semibold section anchors.
visual_direction.icon_strategy: Fluent System Icons use quiet outline commands, a filled selected tool, and semantic status color only on state-bearing symbols.
visual_direction.subject_translation: The reading rhythm follows paper, margin, and annotation: the page is centered, regions are editorial marks, and metadata aligns as margin notes.
visual_direction.signature_move: A thin vertical proof rule links the selected page thumbnail, Region 08 outline, and the Inspector header without drawing decorative connectors.
visual_direction.aesthetic_risk: The Light theme retains a deep neutral pasteboard around the white manga page instead of whitening the whole editor.
visual_direction.risk_guard: Selection uses label, handles, and high-contrast double outline; no essential text sits on the pasteboard.
visual_direction.restraint_rule: The Inspector uses grouped fields and dividers, never a stack of raised cards.

workflow_fit.note: Keeps page, Region selection, and correction in one continuous workbench moment.

product_signature.note: The paper page, selection geometry, and proof marks identify manga editing without a logo.

visual_hierarchy.note: The current page remains visually dominant over supporting controls.

density_and_typography.note: Compact chrome and readable CJK field rhythm retain a usable editing measure.

theme_and_material.note: Mica-adjacent chrome and neutral canvas preserve paper contrast in Light and Dark.

iconography.note: One Fluent System Icons family keeps command, status, and disabled states coherent.

surface_composition.note: Persistent panes or a bounded contextual surface clarify ownership without card stacking.

responsive_quality.note: Narrow panels preserve canvas location and make auxiliary regions mutually exclusive.

visual_direction.palette_strategy: The canvas stays neutral and deep; the drawer uses a warm paper-tinted Fluent layer while error recovery uses contained critical color.
visual_direction.type_strategy: A condensed command cadence makes room for a larger annotation title and generous multiline translation field measure.
visual_direction.icon_strategy: The shared Fluent icon family differentiates transient drawer controls through outline weight and an active close affordance, not a second pack.
visual_direction.subject_translation: A selected speech region produces an editorial side note: the drawer is attached by proximity and state, not by a decorative callout line.
visual_direction.signature_move: The drawer header repeats the selected Region's small cropped paper fragment as a location chip, making context recoverable after zoom.

visual_direction.risk_guard: The temperature shift is limited to the drawer header and field group; semantic contrast and focus tokens remain platform-derived.
visual_direction.restraint_rule: The canvas receives no floating tool palettes beyond the one Inspector drawer.

concepts.title: 校对优先 · 文本与画布分栏
concepts.primary_surface: Canvas paired with a reading-order proofreading sheet
concepts.hero_interaction: Review Region 08's source and translation against the page while adjacent Region rows retain context
concepts.narrow_behavior: The proofreading sheet and canvas become switchable full-height surfaces; only one auxiliary panel is exposed at a time.
concepts.failure_risk: Text rows can visually overtake the manga page and turn the editor into a task list.

visual_direction.name: 校样对照页
visual_direction.composition_character: A deliberate reading spread: a proof sheet establishes text order on the left while the page remains the visual authority on the right.
visual_direction.palette_strategy: Fluent neutral panes use slightly stronger rule contrast; selected text and Region geometry share one restrained teal trace across the spread.
visual_direction.type_strategy: The proof sheet uses an editorial hierarchy with compact source labels, 14 px translated text, and a 16 px active excerpt.
visual_direction.icon_strategy: Fluent System Icons stay compact in the command rail while row state is carried by text, confidence dots, and a single selected marker.
visual_direction.subject_translation: The composition borrows the act of comparing a printed proof against a page: reading order, source text, and result line up as evidence rather than dashboard rows.
visual_direction.signature_move: A selected proof row has a narrow vertical registration mark that aligns with the matching Region's edge on the page.
visual_direction.aesthetic_risk: The proof sheet is intentionally prominent enough to support careful reading rather than a conventional hidden Inspector.
visual_direction.risk_guard: The page keeps the larger visual field, and narrow mode never shows a squeezed proof sheet beside an unusable canvas.
visual_direction.restraint_rule: Rows remain flat and separated by cadence and rules, not individual card containers.

approval.selection_reason: Directly reuses the established three-column layout, responsive drawer, and single EditorViewModel; Inspector sync with canvas selection remains persistent and predictable with minimal state branching.

rejected_concept_reasons.editor-drawer-inspector: Contextual floating drawer introduces extra visibility toggles at normal widths that overlap with narrow-width drawer responsibilities, making selection sync visibility unstable.
rejected_concept_reasons.proofreading-split: Proofreading split-column elevates the text list to a primary object, departing from the canvas-dominant Hero Surface and turning the editor into a task panel collection.

density.wrap_policy: Translation and errors wrap; page labels elide with a tooltip; CommandBar owns low-priority overflow.

theme.light_strategy: Use Fluent semantic window and layered surfaces; retain a neutral dark canvas so page edges and focus geometry are visible.
theme.dark_strategy: Use Fluent semantic dark layers with a slightly lifted neutral pasteboard; preserve paper, selection, and error contrast without forcing the Inspector dark independently.
theme.palette_source: docs/ui/foundations.md §§2–3 and the P5 design intent; no approved identity asset exists yet.
theme.palette_derivation: Map the document's semantic surface, foreground, accent, caution, critical, and focus roles to FluentQt public theme tokens; the paper edge and registration rhythm provide non-color identity.
brand_cues: Paper-centered canvas with a measured surrounding pasteboard.
Thin registration rule aligning the selected thumbnail, page Region, and proof context.

iconography.provenance: Microsoft Fluent System Icons repository, MIT License; use only the single licensed family in the FluentQt-compatible application mapping.
iconography.source_strategy: Reuse one licensed outline family; do not generate a bespoke icon pack before a human-approved direction requires one.
iconography.style: 20 px rounded-outline glyphs with optical centering; selected tools may use the family’s filled variant.
iconography.stroke_policy: Use the family’s supplied stroke language; do not mix arbitrary Unicode, emoji, or a second pack.
iconography.filled_policy: Filled variants mark the currently active tool or persistent selected state only.
iconography.color_policy: Routine icons inherit semantic foreground; accent marks selection; caution and critical are reserved for state-bearing icons and always paired with text.
iconography.icon_only_policy: Every icon-only control exposes a localized accessible name, tooltip, keyboard focus cue, and at least a 32 px target.
iconography.application_icon_strategy: No application tile is claimed in this concepts-stage artifact; selection must later define a separate multi-resolution platform tile from approved identity evidence.
iconography.in_app_mark_strategy: Use no logo treatment in the editor comp; the paper edge and registration rule are the in-product signature.
iconography.small_size_validation: Before implementation, inspect the chosen Fluent icons at 16 px and 20 px in Light, Dark, selected, disabled, and critical states.
iconography.palette_seed: Neutral paper and pasteboard derive from the repository baseline; teal remains a restrained selection cue, not an unapproved brand color.
prohibited: emoji used as an action icon
mixed icon packs in one hierarchy
arbitrary Unicode glyphs or scaled raster icons

copy_policy.audience: Desktop manga translators and proofreaders who need editable, stateful tools.
copy_policy.voice: Direct, calm, and object-first Chinese product copy.
copy_policy.locale_strategy: Use stable Chinese state terms, support CJK/RTL/Emoji and 200% text scaling, wrap recovery text, and give elided labels a tooltip.
compression_rules: Name the object and action first, such as 配置模型 or 应用清除.
Keep persistent status to object plus stage, never an assistant narrative.
Use a three-part error: what happened, the impact, and one direct next step.
forbidden_patterns: assistant self-narration such as I will or I can
unsupported marketing adjectives and duplicated help

component_decisions.need: One-line command grouping with predictable overflow
component_decisions.reason: The editor specification assigns primary and secondary commands with a single-line overflow contract.

component_decisions.need: Page collection with lazy thumbnails and stable scrolling
component_decisions.reason: The supplement explicitly requires Model/View and forbids per-row widget behavior for page thumbnails.

component_decisions.need: Direct manipulation of a 1200×1800 page and Region geometry
component_decisions.reason: The product requires zoom, pan, selection handles, and non-destructive layers beyond a generic Fluent component.
The P5 supplement maps the Inspector to these FluentQt public component families.
The foundations reserve page-space feedback for persistent nonmodal problems with one direct recovery action.

component_decisions.component_id: project-local resizable pane and overlay host
component_decisions.reason: The UI guide explicitly prohibits assuming a FluentQt SplitView public API and requires mutually exclusive page and Inspector overlays.

implementation_spec.container_model: A centered manga canvas on a dark pasteboard flanked by a compact left page rail and a stable right Inspector, transforming into mutually exclusive overlays below 720 px.
semantic_tokens: Map Fluent semantic surfaces, foreground, accent, caution, critical, and focus roles without hard-coded palette values.
Keep the 4 px rhythm, Mica-revealing pane gaps, and neutral canvas relationship.
typography_roles: System UI 14 px CJK body for translation and form content.
System UI 12 px metadata and 16 px semibold section anchors.
component_families: CommandBar, Model/View page collection, MangaCanvas, Fluent Inspector fields, InfoBar.
state_grammar: Selection is double outline plus handles, Region label, and synchronized Inspector context.
Running and model-missing states pair semantic iconography with direct Chinese status and recovery.
motion_cues: Selection and pane continuity use short Fluent transitions; Reduce Motion uses immediate state changes.
responsive_rules: Below 720 px page navigation and Inspector must be mutually exclusive overlays.
Canvas keeps location and core command access while low-priority commands move to overflow.
locked_decisions: Use the approved editor-stable-inspector topology; do not blend with floating drawer or split views.
The current manga page and Region remain the primary object rather than a chat, task, or dashboard surface.
allowed_adaptations: Adapt native FluentQt control anatomy, localization, accessibility, and public API constraints while preserving the approved hierarchy.
known_risks: Narrow viewport (<720 px) requires mutually exclusive page list and inspector overlays to prevent canvas compression.

Detail comparison: model-missing InfoBar and the selected Region editing surface in Light, Dark, normal, and narrow states.
